# telnyx_agent_gateway_policy (Resource)

A named set of guardrails on an Agent Gateway, applied to requests by policy attachments.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "telnyx_agent_gateway_policy" "default" {
  gateway_id  = telnyx_agent_gateway.example.id
  name        = "default"
  description = "Masks personal data in every request."
  guardrails = {
    add = [telnyx_agent_gateway_guardrail.pii.name]
  }
}

resource "telnyx_agent_gateway_policy_attachment" "everything" {
  gateway_id = telnyx_agent_gateway.example.id
  policy     = telnyx_agent_gateway_policy.default.name
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `gateway_id` (String) The gateway id.
- `name` (String) A name, unique on the instance. A request names the policy in its `policies` field.

### Optional

- `base` (String) A policy this one builds on, by name. The policy starts with the base's guardrails.
- `description` (String) What the policy is for.
- `guardrails` (Attributes) The guardrails a policy adds to its base's, and the ones it removes from them, by name. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--guardrails))
- `model` (String) A condition on the model, by name or regular expression. The policy's guardrails run only on requests for a matching model. `null` matches every model.
- `pipeline` (Attributes) Ordered steps, in place of the guardrails running independently. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--pipeline))

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) When the policy's current version was created. An update creates a new version.
- `updated_at` (String) When the policy last changed.

<a id="nestedatt--guardrails"></a>
### Nested Schema for `guardrails`

Optional:

- `add` (Set of String) Guardrails the policy runs in addition to its base's.
- `remove` (Set of String) Guardrails from its base that the policy does not run.


<a id="nestedatt--pipeline"></a>
### Nested Schema for `pipeline`

Optional:

- `hook` (String) `before_request` runs the steps on the request, and `after_request` on the model's response. One of `after_request`, `before_request`.
- `steps` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--pipeline--steps))

<a id="nestedatt--pipeline--steps"></a>
### Nested Schema for `pipeline.steps`

Optional:

- `guardrail` (String) A guardrail on the instance, by name.
- `message` (String) The response that replaces the model's when an outcome is `respond`. Required with `respond`.
- `on_error` (String) What happens when the guardrail errors. Left out, the same as `on_fail`. One of `allow`, `block`, `next`, `respond`.
- `on_fail` (String) What happens when the guardrail fails. One of `allow`, `block`, `next`, `respond`.
- `on_pass` (String) What happens when the guardrail passes. `next` goes on to the next step, `allow` allows the request, `block` blocks it, and `respond` answers with `message`. One of `allow`, `block`, `next`, `respond`.
- `pass_data` (Boolean) `true` hands the step's modified request, such as masked text, to the next step.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import telnyx_agent_gateway_policy.default <gateway_id>/<name>
```
